{{Actor|name=ovl_En_Heishi1|ispage=true}}

'''ovl_En_Heishi1''' is a [[Hylian soldier]] [[actor]] used for patrolling the Castle Courtyard.

Their speed is dependent upon their variables. 0XX is slowest up to 3XX. 4XX is an unused "long range" mode which is finnicky at best and stops the actor after they move one frame. 5XX only appears after Zelda has fled (unsure currently of the exact value searched for in this, I thought it was the Spiritual Stones, but it didn't appear to be)

When they stop they turn their heads for a Random Value +32 frames, this is located at...

Debug Rom - E088DC (25AE0032) - ADDIU T6, T5, 0x0032.
(File Relative +A2C)

The entrance that they throw Link into is located at...

Debug Rom - E08D78 (240904FA) - ADDIU T1, R0, 0x04FA (Being thrown out by guards in Garden)
(File Relative + EC8)
